title: 第25章 大忙特忙
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
蔡老太顾不上那个忽然反常吐唾沫星子、一个劲跟老天爷道歉的儿媳妇。

    她稳住心情，提着牛筋桶快步上前，对着激动不已的儿子说：“先吃饭。”

    如今亲妈的话就跟圣旨没两样，魏建业赶紧应了声，扭头招呼，“都过来先吃饭！”

    谁都没干够，站在原地不动。

    魏建业就把饭盒一个个拍人怀里，神气活现地说：“我妈和我媳妇孩子大老远的扛来，不吃对得起她们吗！”

    他又朝井底喊：“上来吃饭！”

    哎呦喂，都有回声啦。

    井下的人也不干，“你们先吃，我们再掏两桶。”

    蔡老太踱步来水井口。

    毕竟距离两公里呢，这是开挖后她第二回来。

    井口下每隔三十米的地方挂着个人，腰间别着手电筒照明，再往下连人影都瞧不见，只有微弱的灯光。

    蔡老太喊：“孩子，吃饱了才有力气干活呐，后面还有一场硬仗要打。”

    魏建业也跟着喊：“听见没有，我妈能骗你吗。”

    井下边灯光晃荡，陆陆续续爬上来两个人。

    先上来的两个人只是身体打摆子，井底下负责掏泥水的人嘴唇发紫，抖得跟帕金森似的。

    井下寒气重，而且深度将近百米。

    魏建业递过装满粮食酒的茶缸子示意下属暖暖身子，余光瞥过所有人。

    目光交汇的时候，谁的眼眸都亮闪闪的。

    魏建业沉声喊：“全体都有。”

    这会捧着铝饭盒扒饭的、坐着休息的、逗三个孩子玩的、站着溜达的、刚出井缓过劲来的人，立马排成整齐一列对着蔡老太。

    敬礼也是得分场合有标准的，这会不适用，大家伙忽的咧嘴一笑啪啪啪的鼓起掌来。

    魏建业鼓掌得最卖力，掌心都微微发麻啦。

    他现在算是相信亲爸显灵了。

    不过说实在的，父子俩压根就没见过面，这会搁眼前他都不一定认识。

    要说感情，肯定是夫妻感情排在前头。

    指定是他做得不好，连亲爸都看不过眼，搁下头还得操心呐。
content_en:
Mrs. Cai couldn't care less about her daughter-in-law who suddenly spit out stars and kept apologizing to God.

She calmed down, walked forward quickly with the beef tendon bucket, and said to her excited son, "Eat first."

Now his mother's words were no different from an imperial edict. Wei Jianye quickly responded and turned to say hello, "Come over and eat first!"

No one had done enough and stood still.

Wei Jianye clapped the lunch boxes into people's arms one by one, and said with an air of dignity: "My mother, my wife, and my children have come all the way to carry them here. How can I be worthy of them if I don't eat!"

He shouted towards the bottom of the well again: "Come up and eat!"

Ouch, there are echoes.

The people in the well didn't do anything either, "You eat first, and we'll get two more buckets."

Mrs. Cai paced to the entrance of the well.

After all, the distance is two kilometers, and this is her second time back since the excavation.

There is a person hanging every thirty meters below the wellhead, with a flashlight on his waist for illumination. No one can be seen further down, only a weak light.

Mrs. Cai shouted: "My child, you will have the strength to work only when you are full. There is still a tough battle ahead."

Wei Jianye also shouted: "Did you hear that? Can my mother lie to you?"

The light flickered under the well, and two people climbed up one after another.

The two people who came up first were just shaking their bodies. The person responsible for digging out mud and water from the bottom of the well had purple lips and was shaking like Parkinson's disease.

It is very cold underground and the depth is nearly 100 meters.

Wei Jianye handed over a tea jar filled with grain and wine to indicate to his subordinates to warm themselves up, and glanced at everyone from the corner of his eye.

When their eyes met, everyone's eyes were shining.

Wei Jianye shouted in a deep voice: "Everyone has it."

Those who were holding aluminum lunch boxes to eat, those who were sitting and resting, those who were playing with the three children, those who were standing and strolling, and those who had just come out of the well to relax, immediately lined up in a neat line to face Mrs. Cai.

Salutes are also standard for scoring occasions. This does not apply. Everyone suddenly grinned and clapped.

Wei Jianye clapped the hardest, and his palms were slightly numb.

He now believes that his biological father has appeared.

But to be honest, the father and son have never met at all, and he may not even know them now.

When it comes to relationships, the relationship between husband and wife must come first.

It's obvious that he didn't do well enough that even his own father couldn't stand it, so he still had to worry about it when he put his head down.
